findings: Middleware redirect missing — Middleware is a no-op (NextResponse.next()). Lock enforcement relies on page-level checks and API guards. Audit all student-facing routes to confirm coverage.

Possible race condition on lock/unlock — Cached session data may remain valid until next API call, allowing brief access to unlocked content after unlock. This is acceptable (eventual consistency) but worth documenting.
Missing locked page database validation — /student/account-locked page relies on URL status parameter. Should load actual status from database on mount for consistency.

No explicit test coverage documented — Lock enforcement verified at three layers but no unit/integration tests listed. Recommend running manual lock/unlock flow tests: lock → verify 403 on API → unlock → verify access restored.
